How many days do I have to return something?

You have 90 days from the purchase date to return most unused, non-defective items 🙂

A few exceptions:

Items must be unused and in the original packaging
Personalized/custom items and some limited edition items can’t be returned
Orders shipped to Canada aren’t eligible for return
Return label cost is deducted from the refund
